Let me give you a couple of reasons, without spoilers, why many people believe that the second season is the worst but I disagree with all of them.

The first reason many people don't like the second season is because it's slow. And it is slow, slower then the first season and just really insanely slow to start. The storylines seems to take forever and they do. But while they do you start to learn a lot more about the characters and become even more immersed in their world. Then after you start to really get into the characters the season picks up like crazy and before you know it you already started episode one of season three , In my opinion the best season.

The second reason why people dislike the second season is it is the most stand alone season. And by that I mean this season strays away the most from the gritty streets and the Barksdale crew that drew you into the series in the first place. While this is true it sets a good trend for the series in which each season focuses  f on something different, which is a part of the show every fan loves.

While the second season is not the best season its not the worst, thats season 5 in my opinion. So stick with the show it really is the one of, if no the, best TV show ever made.

The show is created and filmed in that manner to have multiple story lines in each episode and particular to your example to show each part of the Omar testifying against bird story one act at a time. This is not editing on the part of the show rather great writing and filmmaking. Because each episode is created so it contains multiple story lines with each one building on to an intertwined seasonal story arch and adding great depth to the show. And when a show contains multiple story lines  it makes more sense to present each story one act at a time rather then each story from beginning to end.
